captions.grid_ack_clrt_tradeoff: Held-out rounds 40–99. Points are the strongest fixed/adaptive/level-aware ACK/CLRT attack across tested models and pools; bars extend to approximate simultaneous upper bounds across four policies and attacks. X values are the largest added median over the three operations.
captions.grid_all_timing_diagnostic: Same comparison including request spacing. This diagnostic is reported separately and does not determine ACK/CLRT policy selection.
captions.grid_coverage_variance_latency: All 100 paired rounds per delay. Coverage is the Timing OFF proxy for joint ACK/response availability, averaged over the 16 configured selections. CLRT variance uses every protected sample and a log axis. Added median latency is the difference between each operation’s protected and paired Timing OFF medians.
